candidate_direction: Use public evidence to form an eligible proposal set, then score and rank that set in bounded batches. Preserve exact verification and the canonical fallback.
causal_question: Can the guide earn its cost when feature computation and ranking cover only proposals that remain useful after public evidence?
common_implementation_rule: Apply each shared evidence filter and ranking optimization to every control.
decision_rule: Evaluate added learned work against semantic frequency and matched lexical guidance under common limits. Preserve the existing matched primary no-go.
freshness_rule: Exclude all behaviors and primitive sets in the source, development, earlier fixed-transfer, and matched cohorts before another scientific run.
next_deliverable: A small opened-family behavior check with explicit proposal and fallback receipts, followed by a frozen fresh-family package.
reporting: complete process CPU and wall cost
